title: Decision-making components and times revealed by the single-trial electroencephalogram
goal: Surpass the source-paper result on the same task: Predict the original fixed HMP-derived inter-event durations from contrast separately by speed/accuracy condition; encoding is event1-to3 and decision event3-to5. Discovery of five events is descriptive calibration.
primary_outputs: Candidate method and outputs for the source task: Predict the original fixed HMP-derived inter-event durations from contrast separately by speed/accuracy condition; encoding is event1-to3 and decision event3-to5. Discovery of five events is descriptive calibration.

Source-paper comparison for Original Table1 contrast-left-out latency RMSE panel, milliseconds; no invented aggregate: Original utility returns sqrt(mean over held-out contrasts of (pooled observed mean duration - equal-participant mean predicted duration)^2), in milliseconds. In-sample trial MSE and curve R2 are separate diagnostics.
success_criteria: Authenticate original512Hz HMP targets and trial selection; reproduce the original Table1 score panel before accepting candidate law predictions.

Keep contrast-left-out folds, all participants, all original interval/condition cells and exact observed/predicted weighting; no correct-only subset score may be compared directly to all-responded Table1.
Fix original latent-duration targets across methods. Moving event estimates to make latency curves easier to predict cannot count as lower prediction error on the same target.
Predeclare a full-panel superiority rule and meaningful effect before candidate feedback; the40.10ms anchor cannot grant a win by itself.

A participant-held-out neural likelihood benchmark, leave-one-session split or100Hz recipe is an extension. Five-event reconstruction, larger coefficients or stronger significance alone is calibration.
The bound improvement contract must be improvement_ready and its complete same-task comparison and admission requirements must pass.
Reproduction is calibration only; reconstructing a numerical result, changing the task or split, or achieving stronger significance alone is not success.

data_contract.neural: 26 files 0_epo.fif through 25_epo.fif, each about 271 MB; publisher and official loader identify cleaned MNE EEG epochs at 512 Hz.
data_contract.labels: Source preprocessing writes epoch metadata event_name, rt, condition, side, stimulus and response, from stimulus/condition/side/response triggers; notebook reads those fields directly for contrast, speed/accuracy and correct-response analyses.
data_contract.time_alignment: Photodiode correction is in the preprocessing source; epochs retain sample rate and events. The initial contract starts after those corrections.
data_contract.split: Freeze participant groups and complete trials for extensions; trial PCA/scaling and HMP model estimation must be training-only if claiming held-out prediction. Original full-data event discovery is a descriptive reproduction.
data_contract.controls: Behavior-only reaction time, response/motor preparation, contrast intensity, and alternative event widths/numbers; test that HMP interval interpretations survive participant-held-out estimation.
data_contract.biological_unit: Participant, not the number of fitted EEG samples or event-probability points.

versions_and_loader_contract.scope_description: Refit hidden multivariate pattern events on released participant EEG epochs, then compare sensory/decision interval laws and ERP evidence. Scope starts from cleaned epochs and does not recreate manual acquisition/preprocessing decisions.

input_assets.checksum_interpretation: Explicit sha256 fields retained; checksum/digest/ETag names are not silently reinterpreted. None means unrecorded, not verified.

official_code.lineage_limit: Author/source code meaning is preserved. A loader, demo, figure script and complete-paper implementation are not interchangeable.

provenance.interpretation: Pins bind saved local evidence. Asset hashes are source-reported unless an explicit acquisition receipt says otherwise.

episode.improvement_loop: After source reconciliation, allow iteration on training/development law fits while final contrast errors remain inaccessible to candidate selection; source target generation is fixed.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze candidate law, parameter constraints, all fit-contrast memberships, population choice and complete-panel comparison rule before final evaluation.
episode.final_evaluation: Recompute original contrast-left-out RMSE for the full source panel against authentic source predictions and report event/ERP reproduction separately.
episode.baseline_policy: The published table is a numerical source result; exported score kernels are engineering components; rerun author results remain absent. Missing budgets and target parity block activation.
